items.title: 思格新能源发布行业首个全域AI智能体，能源管理进入智能体时代
items.raw_excerpt: 5月29日，全球领先的智慧新能源科技企业思格新能源（06656.HK）在其“AI in All”全球战略发布会上，正式推出了能源行业首个全域AI智能体——SigenAgent。这是思格新能源自4月16日上市后首次发布全球战略，标志着能源管理进入“AI智能体时代”。 发布会上，思格新能源还携手弗若斯特沙利文联合发布《2026 AI+新能源白皮书》。白皮书参考自动驾驶分级逻辑，全球首次推出能源智能化五级分级体系 EIL（Energy Intelligence Level）。 思格新能源董事长、CEO许映童在发布会上表示：“新能源系统越来越复杂，用户的用电场景和需求也各不相同，AI与能源的融合因此成为必然。真正的AI不只是陪你聊天的助手，而是一个能听懂你的目标、替你干活、并且会不断学习的伙伴。” 思格新能源发布SigenAgent：能源行业首个全域AI智能体震撼亮相 作为发布会的核心亮点，SigenAgent的正式揭幕标志着新能源行业迈入“AI智能体时代”。与传统大模型“一问一答、推一步动一步”的被动交互不同，SigenAgent的颠覆之处在于“使命必达”。 SigenAgent，其核心架构由私人能源管家、电站运维医生、电力交易操盘手和企业经营助手四大垂直AI智能体组成，精准覆盖包括家庭用户、电站运维、电力交易和企业经营四大核心场景。 私人能源管家：让家庭光储进入“自动驾驶”时代。用户无需研究复杂参数，也不必反复切换操作界面，只需提出节省电费、提升自发自用率、保障备电等目标，系统便会结合家庭负载、光伏发电、电池状态与电价规则，自动生成运行策略，并在用户确认后完成参数配置与策略执行，让家庭能源管理从“专业操作”转向“目标表达”。 电站运维医生：开启绿电资产“秒级诊疗”时代。过去，运维人员往往需要人工查看数据、导出日志、逐项排查告警，现场沟通与远程确认成本高昂。借助SigenAgen

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 29, Sigenergy (06656.HK), a global leader in smart new energy technology, officially launched SigenAgent, the first full-domain AI agent in the energy industry, at its "AI in All" global strategy conference. This marked Sigenergy's first global strategy release since its listing on April 16, signaling the entry of energy management into the "AI agent era." At the conference, Sigenergy also partnered with Frost & Sullivan to release the "2026 AI+New Energy White Paper." Drawing on autonomous driving classification logic, the white paper introduced the world's first five-tier energy intelligence grading system, EIL (Energy Intelligence Level). Sigenergy's Chairman and CEO, Xu Yingtong, stated at the conference: "New energy systems are becoming increasingly complex, with diverse user scenarios and needs, making the integration of AI and energy inevitable. True AI is not just a chat companion but a partner that understands your goals, works for you, and continuously learns." Sigenergy Launches SigenAgent: The First Full-Domain AI Agent in the Energy Industry Makes a Stunning Debut As the highlight of the conference, the official unveiling of SigenAgent marked the new energy industry's entry into the "AI agent era." Unlike traditional large models that rely on passive, one-question-one-answer interactions, SigenAgent's revolutionary feature lies in its "mission-accomplished" capability. excerpt_i18n.es: El 29 de mayo, la empresa líder mundial en tecnología de nueva energía inteligente, Sigen New Energy (06656.HK), presentó oficialmente en su conferencia global de estrategia "AI in All" el primer agente de IA integral del sector energético: SigenAgent. Este es el primer lanzamiento de estrategia global de Sigen New Energy desde su salida a bolsa el 16 de abril, marcando la entrada de la gestión energética en la "era de los agentes de IA". Durante la conferencia, Sigen New Energy también publicó conjuntamente con Frost & Sullivan el "Libro Blanco de AI+ Nueva Energía 2026".
